declarations.name: AuiYearPicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI YearPicker: `<aui-year-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group (via aria-labelledby). Must be a non-empty string.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Inclusive lower bound (integer year; validation and popup). Must not be after max.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Inclusive upper bound (integer year; validation and popup).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; a hidden input carries the year as zero-padded YYYY.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text (text only) referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: An empty entry is invalid (value-missing); the segment is required and the required indicator is shown.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the segment and the button; the popup does not open and the value is not submitted.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted, but not editable; the popup does not open.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation after the built-in checks; return a non-empty message to mark the value invalid (error 'custom').

inputs.name: isYearDisabled
inputs.description: Return true to disable a year: focusable in the popup but not selectable; typed, it is invalid (error 'unavailable').

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Advanced: fixed today instead of the current date in timezone; it decides the current year. For tests, server rendering, and demos with a fixed clock.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides: calendar, previous, next, error.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Close the popup after a year is picked.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Year formatting, headings, labels, and messages.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Zone used only to determine the current year (aria-current, default focus, and the start of stepping an empty segment).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Popup and grid direction: grid arrow-key mirroring, chevrons, and popup alignment (applied when the popup opens).

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the value or its validity error (typing, stepping, or picking a year).

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the popup is open.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the popup and focus the selected year (or the current year), clamped to min/max. No-op when open, disabled, or read-only.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the popup; focus inside it returns to the button.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (for every validation timing) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); null or '' clears it; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: Zero-padded YYYY, or null when the value is null.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state (no events).

accessibility.pattern: Single-segment year field in a labelled group with a button that opens a non-modal dialog popup (WAI-ARIA APG date picker dialog pattern, non-modal variant) containing a paged role=grid of years with a roving tabindex.

limitations: Gregorian (proleptic) years 1 to 9999 only; year 0 and negative years are not supported.
The year must be typed with four digits (0005 for year 5).
Only ASCII digits are accepted; other characters are removed.
Single years only; year ranges need two pickers.
The popup has no Cancel/OK buttons: picking a year commits it.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
